name: starter
description: Hand-written questions over the three-document reference corpus. Every question deliberately paraphrases its source rather than reusing its wording, so dense retrieval has to do real work; spans were derived from paragraph anchors and validated against the corpus. Covers concepts, metrics, method, and operational prose.
notes: Committed so `pnpm eval:run -- --config baseline` works on a fresh clone with no generation step. 27 items is small — treat differences under a few points as noise, and grow the set with `pnpm eval:gen` before acting on a narrow delta.
